julia (partnerships): FYI CobaltTech submitted a joint-launch intake for RetailOne. They want SI-first outreach + HW rack procurement timing aligned with announcement. tagging @marc @rohit
marc (acct_exec): Do we have any conflict on territory or existing AE ownership?
julia (partnerships): SFDC shows no active opps. Cobalt claims they ran a discovery and have a scoping doc.
rohit (solutions_arch): Can they share the scoping doc + lab test results? If HW timing is involved we need clear lead times.
bev (legal): If this becomes a joint public announcement we require a mutual embargo clause + standard co-marketing agreement.
julia (partnerships): Proposed process: 1) Create intake tag "si_handshake:cobalttech" 2) Grant 30d claim window for Strategic SI with evidence (scoping doc OR demo) 3) If hardware order >= 10 units, escalate to ops for provisioning lead time check 4) Auto-escalate to AE after claim window or if SI misses 48h response SLA
marc (acct_exec): 30d OK for strategic SI. Add a thin audit trail: intake webhook should push claim_reason and evidence_url to SFDC.
rohit (solutions_arch): For provisioning, ops needs SKU list + expected delivery dates. We should include a single line sample: `provision_payload: {sku:RT-6000, qty:12, target:2026-06-15}`
deploybot (bot): Created task PRT-4901: "CobaltTech RetailOne SI intake - claim + HW gating" assigned to partnerships, ops, legal.
julia (partnerships): Next actions: @cobalt rep must upload scoping doc or demo link within 72h or exclusive claim void. @bev prepare NDA template for co-announce. @marc please seed AE into the loop and open deal desk on potential margin splits.
marc (acct_exec): Will do, looping in AE and deal-desk now.
bev (legal): I'll draft the co-marketing TOU and embargo clause. Rough ETA EOD tomorrow.
rohit (solutions_arch): Also flagging integration risk: if they require custom kernel tuning we may need research sign-off before announcement. Adding a note in the ticket.
julia (partnerships): Good call. We'll include an "integration_risk" tag. Also creating a short one-pager for partners that summarizes timelines, labeling it `SI-Handbook-v2` and dropping into the task.
deploybot (bot): Task PRT-4901 updated: claim_window=30d, response_sla=48h, evidence_deadline=72h, tags=[si_handshake, hw_gating, integration_risk].
julia (partnerships): Thanks everyone. Ill follow up once legal has the NDA and AE has confirmed coverage. :rocket:
